title: POST /api/pairing/generate (body, optional)
description: PIN for a new device. access: member (default) or guest. profile_id missing or null = default profile of the device type that pairs (house settings; guest: default guest profile). Guests: duration guest_hours (default guest_default_hours, max guest_access.max_hours) or guest_expires_at. 422 profile.guest_child_protection for a guest with a parental-controls profile.

guest_expires_at.description: Own end of the guest access; not together with guest_hours (422 guest.expires).
